title: AI Engineer
description:
Principal AI Engineer - Surrey/London (4:1) - Up to £150,000

We're partnering with an innovative technology company building enterprise-grade AI products that enable organisations to safely deploy, orchestrate and govern AI at scale.

As a Principal AI Engineer, you'll work closely with senior leadership to design and build production-ready AI agent systems, focusing on reliability, observability, security and real-world business outcomes rather than proof-of-concept demonstrations.

Key Skills & Experience

  • Expertise in Python and modern agent frameworks such as LangGraph.
  • Hands-on experience with RAG, tool calling, orchestration and evaluation methodologies.
  • Solid software engineering fundamentals across cloud infrastructure, APIs, databases and distributed systems.
  • Experience balancing model quality, latency, scalability and cost optimisation.
  • Understanding of AI security, governance and enterprise deployment challenges.

Why Apply?

  • Opportunity to shape the architecture of a cutting-edge AI platform.
  • Direct collaboration with senior technical leadership.
  • Significant technical ownership and influence.
  • Competitive salary and equity package.
  • Hybrid working in Central London.

Interested? Get in touch with Joshua at for more information.

All applicants MUST be UK-based with full right to work in the UK.

Tenth Revolution Group are the go-to recruiter for Data & AI roles in the UK offering more opportunities across the country than any other recruitment agency. We're the proud sponsor and supporter of SQLBits, Power Platform World Tour, and the London Fabric User Group. We are the global leaders in Data & AI recruitment.
